recipes.name: Best Ever Vegan Nutella
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*.
Spread the hazelnuts onto the baking tray. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden and fragrant**.
When cooled enough to handle (but still warm) pick up the hazelnuts a handful at a time and rub firmly between the palms of your hands (or in a clean kitchen cloth) so the skin falls off.
Place the peeled hazelnuts in a high-speed food processor (ideally 600W or higher)***.
Blend on high for about 8 minutes, until the hazelnut butter is smooth and runny****.
Add the remaining ingredients and blend again until smooth.
Taste test. For a thinner consistency, consider adding an extra tablespoon each of coconut oil and maple syrup. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. If you prefer a distinct coconut taste, use unrefined coconut oil instead. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** Careful to not overcook, as the nuts continue to 'toast' when taken out of the oven. *** Using a blender for this is not advised, as there is not enough liquid. **** If your food processor isn't very powerful, blend for an extra 5 minutes or add a bit of vegetable oil for smoother processing. If the mixture gets too hot, let it cool slightly to prevent damaging your food processor.
Storage Store in a mason jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
